answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through time-locked collateral deposits staked in a lotus escrow contract. Each prospective node must lock liquid capital, which verifiers slash if conflicting execution claims are detected through an auditing prism. An attacker cultivating a meadow of synthetic identities incurs the scarce opportunity cost of committed funds per instance. However, high bonding costs favor wealthy cartels, pricing out resource-constrained honest agents.
